notes: Staged watch fixture only. Activate after CBRS post-IPO option chain liquidity stabilizes and a current catalyst/probability is reviewed.

theses.thesis: Cerebras reprices as a direct frontier-compute scarcity asset if post-IPO demand validates non-NVIDIA accelerator demand faster than options imply.
theses.catalyst: post-IPO liquidity and first public-market demand/disclosure cycle
theses.plannedExit: exit on first post-catalyst liquid mark or if spread/IV makes the vertical uneconomic
theses.falsifier: chain remains too wide, customer concentration dominates narrative, or public disclosures fail to support accelerated demand

theses.thesis: Cerebras post-IPO AGI scarcity premium can unwind if valuation, float, customer concentration, or software-ecosystem concerns dominate after the initial demand spike.
theses.catalyst: post-IPO volatility normalization and first public-market digestion
theses.plannedExit: exit on first post-catalyst liquid mark or if downside IV/spreads absorb the edge
theses.falsifier: sustained institutional demand, improving liquidity, and disclosures that validate durable frontier-compute scarcity premium
